title: Small Scale Landslide Detection Using Sentinel-1 Interferometric SAR Coherence

task_anchor.seed_role: task seed exclusion; not included as a reference direction

anchor_context.selection_basis: User-selected seed: highest citation count among the four 2020 candidates and strongest central overlap with the remaining SLC+DEM reference space.

idea.research_question: Can interferometric coherence change derived from Sentinel-1 SLC pairs detect small landslides accurately enough to support rapid hazard assessment and early warning?
idea.hypothesis: A landslide produces a spatially localized loss of interferometric coherence that remains distinguishable from vegetation and terrain effects after DEM-supported processing and ancillary masking.
idea.mechanism: Sentinel-1 SLC pairs preserve phase information used to estimate interferometric coherence. SRTM DEM supports co-registration, topographic-phase removal and terrain correction, while Sentinel-2 vegetation information and reference landslide areas help separate genuine surface disturbance from background decorrelation.

key_variables.target: Landslide versus non-landslide area and the spatial extent of detected slope failure
predictors: Coherence difference and normalized coherence difference
Vegetation state and landslide reference masks

idea.analytical_approach: 对事件前后Sentinel-1 SLC影像进行DEM辅助配准、地形相位去除和地形校正，生成干涉相干性；计算相干性差值与归一化相干性差值，通过植被掩膜和参考滑坡范围控制非灾害退相干，并使用ROC、检测率、误报率和总体精度评价识别能力。
idea.expected_contribution: 建立一个以SLC相位信息和DEM地形处理为核心的小尺度滑坡相干性变化检测框架，并明确其用于灾害快速识别和早期预警的有效边界。
idea.falsification_condition: 若相干性变化在独立滑坡和非滑坡区域之间不可稳定区分，或在控制植被、地形和观测几何后检测结果仍具有高误报率且不能跨事件复现，则该相干性变化机制不成立。
